name: special
description: Nonstandard jobs that belong to no crystal: Freelancer is available from the start, and Mime comes from the Sunken Walse Tower. Run types that allow them offer them for any job slot, and job sets do not filter them out.

name: advance
description: The GBA-only Advance jobs, assigned by the Extra Jobs option. They belong to no crystal and no job set.
Jobs that can break elemental rods or share that caster play style (rods cost 750 gil).

name: no750
description: Jobs that cannot break elemental rods and follow that non-caster play style (rods cost 750 gil).

name: classic
description: Classic run pool: jobs that appeared in the original Final Fantasy. Used for all four job slots.
